You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository swesmith/Suor__funcy.207a7810.

Problem Statement:
Fix the two-part result of funcy.split_by.

The first part must contain the longest consecutive prefix of the input for which the predicate is true. The second part must contain the remainder, starting with the first item for which the predicate is false. Later items that satisfy the predicate stay in the remainder; this function does not partition all input items by predicate value.

For example, splitting [1, 2, 3] with the predicate lambda x: x % 2 should yield [1] in the first part and [2, 3] in the second part. Preserve input order and the existing lazy-iterator behavior; lsplit_by should expose the same two parts as lists.
